sketches.mechanism: The `object` declaration creates a singleton — exactly one instance that can never be duplicated or reconstructed.
sketches.resonance: Some things exist only once; the language guarantees there will never be another.

sketches.mechanism: The `forever` combinator repeats an action indefinitely, but wrapping `return ()` — doing nothing — in `forever` creates an infinite loop of producing nothing.
sketches.resonance: Waiting forever is still doing something, even when nothing arrives.

sketches.mechanism: The `method_missing` hook intercepts calls to methods that don't exist, letting an object respond to anything — but only with absence.
sketches.resonance: You answer every question I ask, but none of the answers exist yet.
sketches.draft:
class You
  def method_missing(what, *_)
    method_missing(what)
  end
end

You.new.stay
